chapter_seo_title: Shaoyin Clan Flees to the Seamless Gate After Xia Emperor Refuses Help
chapter_meta_description: Cornered by evidence of Ji Ning’s monstrous power, Poison Claw Immortal uproots his entire clan in minutes. When the Xia Emperor refuses a truce, he defects to the Seamless Gate. The board is set.
og_title: The Shaoyin Clan Makes Its Choice – Poison Claw Immortal Defects to the Seamless Gate
og_description: In one of the swiftest political gambits in the Grand Xia, the Shaoyin Patriarch abandons his fiefdom, relocates his people into a treasure world, and throws in his lot with the Seamless Gate after the Xia Emperor chooses Ji Ning’s side.
twitter_title: ⚔️ Shaoyin Clan Goes Rogue – Patriarch Defects to Seamless Gate!
twitter_description: When the Xia Emperor refuses peace with Ji Ning’s faction, Poison Claw Immortal evacuates his entire clan and joins the enemy. The war is brewing.

lore_anchors.definition: A recording immortal technique that captures visual scenes of past events through water projection. Used by immortals for intelligence or evidence transmission.
An Innate spirit treasure containing an independent world, capable of housing billions. The Shaoyin clan uses it as a mobile refuge.
The Patriarch of the Shaoyin clan, a cunning survivor from the ancient Pangu era, known for his ruthless pragmatism and habit of fleeing rather than fighting lost causes.
The ruler of the Grand Xia Dynasty, a political actor who calculates the value of his subjects and chooses to side with Ji Ning over the established Shaoyin clan.
A territory within the Seamless Gate’s network, governed by a mysterious azure-robed woman acting as a local Gate Lord.
The Seamless Gate’s controller in the Fifth World; she manipulated events to drive the Shaoyin clan into defection.
The empty, Dao-resonance-less void between the Three Realms and the broader Chaosverse; a hostile environment where cultivators cannot rely on their Daos.
A rival faction to the Grand Xia Dynasty, operating across multiple worlds, known for infiltrating and subverting local powers.
A cultivator who has survived the Heavenly Tribulation, becoming an immortal with limitless lifespan. The second-tier of immortality below True Immortals.
A treasure born from primordial natural forces, possessing sentience and its own spiritual nature. More difficult to refine than manufactured treasures.
